entries.rationale: The imported row conflated an OpenAlex discovery-metadata record with the journal article and supplied an unsupported Müller-Kessler attribution. The current OpenAlex record names Jane Ford, while the journal and author-institution records identify the article author as J. N. Ford. Keep the OpenAlex row as metadata and use SRC-FORD2002-JANES for the article.
